en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5689 - Zur'ah narrated from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked Imam (as) about a man who struck his pregnant daughter, causing her to miscarry a stillborn child. The woman's husband sought justice against her father.
The woman then said to her husband: "If this miscarriage has a diyyah (blood money) and I have a share of inheritance in it, then I give my share to my father."
Imam (as) said: "What she gifted to her father is permissible for him to receive."
